text:
Micah Rivera: Quick heads-up — Lina Ortiz (candidate) is in Sydney and her final loop was scheduled for Wed 9am PT which is 2am AET for her. Can we move to a later window or provide an APAC-friendly option? Resume: https://example.com/resumes/lina-ortiz.pdf
Alana Chen: Thanks for flagging. Moving later sounds right. Would 4pm PT work (that’s 9am AEST)? Also does she need any paperwork/visa letter or special travel assistance? Any dietary restrictions if we end up doing an in-person meeting?
Rebecca Park: 4pm PT works for me. Devin and I are available then. We should confirm a loaner laptop — Lina mentioned she prefers to use a Windows machine for the coding task.
Devin Shaw: I can move to 4pm PT. We have one spare Win laptop but it’s currently at HQ build bench. Micah — would candidate accept a shipped loaner or remote screen-share if shipping timing is tight?
Micah Rivera: She explicitly asked for a loaner. Also she needs a formal invite letter for a visa support doc (not a full visa, just an employer letter). CC @Alana. I’ll need expense code for travel reimbursements / shipping cost.
Alana Chen: Expense code is TRVL-HIRING. For the invite letter I need: full legal name, passport number, purpose, and exact dates. Please DM those details (don’t post here). We can ship a Windows loaner — shipping ETA usually 2 business days if sent next-day. If that’s too late we can provide a Zoom + on-site backup at the office.
Micah Rivera: She can provide passport details today. I'll DM you. Shipping address is her residential address in Sydney (will include in the DM). She also asked for live captions and transcribed notes; can we enable that in the Zoom invite?
Alana Chen: Yes — we'll enable live captions and add a note to the invite that recorded transcript will be available. Micah — please confirm whether laptop needs to be pre-loaded with our test repo and Windows dev tools. If so, send the repo link and we’ll image it before shipping.
Rebecca Park: I’ll attach the coding assignment and test repo link to the candidate thread once slot is locked. Micah, please update the calendar invite to include Zoom link + shipping fallback (on-site room XYZ if they make it).
Micah Rivera: Done — calendar invite updated with Zoom + on-site backup and preliminary itinerary: 4pm PT / 9am AEST — interview panel: Rebecca, Devin, Satya, and Priya (pep talk). Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder scheduled: Ship loaner laptop by EOD tomorrow to meet 2-business-day ETA. Use shipping code: HIRE-LOGISTICS.
Alana Chen: Final note — once Micah sends the passport info I’ll draft the employer letter and route for signature. Also adding reimbursement guidance to the invite (TRVL-HIRING). Micah, please mark the candidate as "loaner required" in Greenhouse so ops can track the asset.
Micah Rivera: Will do. Thanks everyone — will DM Alana now with passport + address and post back here once shipment is booked. :thumbsup:
Rebecca Park: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
